title: Tosca Automation Test Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities : Lead the design, development, and maintenance of robust automation frameworks and scripts using Tricentis Tosca for SAP ECC / S4HANA / Fiori / SAP GUI environments. Identify automation opportunities across SAP modules (FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, WM, etc.) and collaborate with functional and technical stakeholders to define optimized test coverage. Oversee and guide the team in developing model-based test automation for UI, API, and data layer testing. Manage and monitor automation execution cycles, ensuring stable regression runs, timely defect analysis, and effective troubleshooting. Drive the integration of Tosca automation suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins or equivalent) and ensure seamless execution through tools like qTest or JIRA. Perform and review root-cause analysis of automation failures, recommending improvements to enhance reliability, reusability, and maintainability. Establish and maintain comprehensive documentation standards covering test data, test scripts, execution reports, and handover materials. Partner closely with SAP project teams to ensure automation solutions align with business goals, release timelines, and quality standards. Mentor junior automation engineers, provide technical guidance, review deliverables, and ensure adherence to best practices. Support planning, effort estimation, sprint alignment, and overall automation roadmap execution. 

 Preferred candidate profile : 5 to 14 years of experience in SAP automation, with strong hands-on expertise in Tricentis Tosca (lead or senior role preferred). Deep knowledge of Tosca model-based automation, including test case design, execution, and reporting. Solid understanding of SAP business processes across modules (FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, etc.). Strong technical expertise in Tricentis Tosca, including setup and configuration of Tosca Commander, Tosca Server, Distributed Execution (DeX), and Test Data Service (TDS). Proven experience in developing and managing Tosca integrations with test management tools using Tosca Connect (e.g., Jira, qTest, SAP SolMan, SAP CALM, TestRail). Strong stakeholder engagement skills with experience working directly with client teams and senior stakeholders. Exposure to other automation tools such as UiPath, Playwright, and UFT is highly desirable. Proven experience integrating automation with CI/CD frameworks such as Jenkins. Strong working knowledge of test management tools like qTest, ALM, or JIRA. Demonstrated capability in leading and managing an automation team of 46 resources, ensuring delivery quality and timelines. Experience in training, coaching, or mentoring new or junior automation engineers. Candidate should have strong knowledge in SAP Success factor and SAP Ariba applications Candidate must be TA1, Tosca OnPrem and Cloud product consultant certified Candidate should have strong knowledge in Tosca Cloud, AI Workspace, MCPs, Agentic Test Automation and Agentic Test Creation Candidate should have good exposure to ToscaOnPrem to Cloud Migration Experience in Tosca DI, Mobile Automation, OSV is an added advantage. 
 Perks and benefits : Tools, training, and freedom to grow We equip you with the resources and flexibility to succeed on your terms. Focused career development – Through mentorship, hands-on experience, and structured learning, we help you build the skills and mindset to thrive. Inclusive and supportive culture – We value every individual’s unique perspective and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels seen, heard, and appreciated. Flexible work options – Enjoy the benefits of hybrid or remote work arrangements that support your lifestyle and productivity. Opportunities to work on impactful projects – Collaborate with industry leaders and clients on cutting-edge technologies and meaningful work. Recognition and rewards – We celebrate contributions and achievements regularly, ensuring your efforts never go unnoticed. Well-being and work-life balance – We care about your holistic well-being, with initiatives and policies that promote balance, wellness, and fulfilment.

Key Skills: Tricentis Tosca,SAP Module,Automation,SAP testing,Tosca Automation,SAP Automation,Software testing,Tosca
